objective: Decide by SAT over every state, for every class of the three- and four-atom spaces, whether each acting atom holds a unit and units beyond them are free (R-a to R-c).
status: Proved by exact computation 2026-11-10 (SAT over every state, 1,280 classes, 11 spaces; pre-registered): all atoms acting leaves no floor state; otherwise each acting atom holds a unit; with fewer acting atoms than units the rest are free. The READ-ADDRESS exception is that case.
title: The rule behind the exception
